The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Fuse fires up the BBQ, but an uninvited guest arrives: a teeny-tiny house spider! Fuse tries to play it cool and goes to extreme lengths to avoid it. Then, Slick's dad shows up out of the blue, so he pretends that Jeff's house is his and that Jeff is his butler! How long can they keep up the secret? Finally, Pogo and Bubbles get stranded in the desert!

Join Blippi for some fun snowy day adventures! First, he heads to Leavenworth Ski Hill for some learning fun in the snow. He learns all about numbers, colors and shapes while exploring. During his visit, he also learns all about cool winter vehicles like snowmobiles! The snowy adventure ends with a festive visit to a Reindeer Farm, where Blippi learns all about the beautiful animals that make Christmas so special.

Join Blippi and Meekah as they learn different ways to care for the planet! First they celebrate Earth Day by getting their hands dirty with composting and planting, learning about the importance of healthy soil. Then the adventure takes them to the Daytona International Speedway where Blippi learns about recycling tires and how powerful solar panels can be used to create clean energy.

Meekah is playing with huge diggers and trains! First, she visits PlayLab to play with animal toys and learn American Sign Language signs for a block-building activity. Then, she explores a construction-themed playground to learn about excavators and cement mixing before taking a tractor ride! The fun continues at Kinderland where she builds a huge soft bridge for her toy train and acts like different vehicles!

Get ready for the ultimate water park adventure with Meekah! She's ready for fun in the sun with her hat, sunscreen and a toy boat! She sets out to find the fastest slide and the slowest ride by using her toy boat and Wonder Watch to time them. Then, Blippi and Meekah find a treasure map at Wild Rivers waterpark! By following the map, they embark on an adventure to discover hidden treasure. Let's see if that special treasure sinks or floats!

Get ready for a delicious pizza pie adventure with Blippi! First, he stops by the play supermarket inside Billy Beez to buy all the ingredients he needs to make a tasty pizza. Then, Blippi learns how to make an authentic Italian pizza from a real pizza-maker! He goes on a scavenger hunt for veggie toppings, makes the dough from scratch and cooks his handmade pizza in an outdoor wood oven. So cheesy good!

What's cooking? Blippi is! He's visiting a cooking school to learn how to be a chef. He puts on his apron and learns how to follow a recipe to make a delicious and healthy meal. It's a fun and educational look at the art of cooking that will make you hungry for more.

Get ready for a super fun scavenger hunt with the Park Rangers! First, Park Rangers Maddie and Zoey find that all their gear has vanished. As they search for clues to solve the mystery, they stumble upon a mysterious surprise box! Then, the Gadget Wizard has hidden all the T-Rex Ranch dinosaurs! The Park Rangers are on a scavenger hunt to recover them, solving clues and overcoming challenges to find and return the missing dinosaurs!

The Park Rangers are busy counting dinos and catching intruders! First, Park Rangers Maddie and Zoey go on a T-Rex Ranch adventure to count all the Dimetrodons Dinosaurs. Can they check them all safely? Then, Park Ranger Darren accidentally spills coffee on his computer, causing all the park cameras to go down! Meanwhile, a clever intruder sneaks into the park, using cookies as a distraction to bypass security.

The Dino Master has made his evil return to T-Rex Ranch! When a mysterious dino egg appears at the Ranch, the conflicted Park Rangers decide to keep it safe after the Dino Master threatens to steal it. But his evil return continues! Asher's decision to rebuild the Dino Master's 'Dino Eye' gadget has terrible consequences when the Dino Master returns as a hologram to control his mind.

It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

Things are getting wild for the Oddbods! First, Bubbles is transformed into a bee-sized creature after an accident with one of her experiments. While facing the dangers of the world, she must get Newt's help to turn back to her normal self. Then, an incident with Fuse sends Jeff off the deep end, and he quickly descends into a feral state! Fuse and Newt must work together to rehabilitate their friend back to normality.

The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Roy Radin was a successful New York theatrical producer with a knack for making money and a taste for the high life. His hopes for making it as a Hollywood producer ended abruptly in a remote canyon outside of Los Angeles. His connections with a major Hollywood producer and with a Miami cocaine dealer had investigators baffled as to who was responsible for his execution. Before the case came to trial, it would take several years and the dogged determination of Los Angeles Sheriff’s Investigator, Bill Stoner. Facing a battery of high-priced defense attorneys, Prosecutors David Conn and Sally Thomas would spend a year in court trying to bring four killers to justice. Silent Partner is a story seemingly taken from the pages of a dime novel – but in this case, the truth is even more chilling than fiction.

Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. Get ready for chaos as Magical Pet powers run wild! First, Bubblebear creates so many bubbles that they join together and become a giant Bubble Monster that traps everyone! Then, when Shrubcub gets sick, Pet Port is invaded by wayward vines, and the friends have to race against time to get her some magic tea. The wild powers continue as Slushyseal turns buildings and cars into giant juice pops that start to melt all over town!

Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

Learn how to be safe and strong this month! Discover the importance of washing your hands after playing and learn basic swimming skills. Practice hard to master your Taekwondo moves and play a fun imagination game of 'The Floor is Lava!'

The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend and a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer and has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, and when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health and Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show and a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her and she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control and causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show and tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

Join Cody on a learning adventure! Ride the bus with your family, see a cool recycling truck up close, and celebrate a dinosaur-themed birthday. Help with backyard chores with a toy digger and learn that it's okay to be sad sometimes.

Learn and grow with friends this month! Imagine you're a soccer star, sing about colors, and learn the magic words 'please' and 'thank you.' Bake alphabet cupcakes and learn that it's okay when playtime doesn't go exactly as planned.

Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. The spell not only cleaned Charlie’s wall but made grey stripes on the walls of every house in Abra-Dabra! Even Tiggy’s yellow house is all grey!! So Deedee and everybody else pitch in and paint every house back to its original colour. So the final building standing is the town hall, but no one has sufficient pain for any one colour. So they finally decide to paint it with every colour they have, like a rainbow!

Tiggy is all flustered and confused as he’s not prepared, nor has any idea what to make for a surprise lunch he promised Mayor De Pfeffel. Seems Deedee’s magic is the only answer. The spell she conjures makes Tiggy be totally decided on the recipe that he sees first. And when the spell is cast, the recipe book opens up exactly at the recipe of a pie made of Tika Pila flowers. The problem is that only the Doobydoos can pick the Tika Pila flowers as it grows in the most prickly cacti in Abra-Dabra! But no matter how much Deedee and Nino coax Tiggy to work on another recipe; Tiggy is totally fixated on the Tika Pila flower pie. Though the Doobydoos love eating the flowers, they are too scared of the loud and angry Tika Pila monster that guards them and rush off in a hurry. They finally hit a bargain with Tiggy in exchange for a hundred custard sandwiches. Only with much reassuring and coaxing they pick every Tika Pila flower around. Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

p.t: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E03 - Urban Oceans, Super Corals
p.d: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

p.t: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
p.d: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

p.t: Survive the Wild - S01:E01 - Rules of the Realm
p.d: Animals or groups protect their territory by using sounds like birds singing or scents like pheromones from many mammals to mark boundaries. These are just the initial warnings. If other animals ignore these signs, a conflict might happen. Animals need a secure territory to mate, raise their young, and ensure there's enough food and resources for survival. This episode looks at the strategies animals use to claim their territory.

p.t: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
p.d: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

p.t: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
p.d: In this episode we visit two different corners of our planet. Although thousands of kilometres apart, spiritually they are close relatives. First, Ethiopia in East Africa which is dissected by the Great African Rift Valley and considered by many to be the cradle of humankind. Next, a paradise on Earth: Jamaica.

p.t: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
p.d: Today‘s journey in search of more miracles of nature brings us to the Masurian Lake District which is an impressive water world in north-eastern Poland. We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe’s Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

p.t: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
p.d: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.
